a ring-turnstile slot-LP antenna with a 2.3-fold reduction in the turn-on frequency is proposed, designed, fabricated and characterized for dual-circular polarized (CP), high-power bidirectional applications.
a new antenna design is proposed that is 2 times smaller than a conventional log-periodic antenna and is high power capable.
the proposed antenna is a reduced size, high power capable bidirectional dual-CP LP antenna with a wide bandwidth.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, fabrication and characterization of a novel dual-polarized log-periodic antenna for high-power bidirectional applications.
the design of high-power bidirectional antennas.
the development of a novel antenna design that is smaller, lighter, and more efficient for use in high-power transmit/receive systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented design concept can be used to design a compact, dual-circular-polarized antenna with high power capability.

this work demonstrates a novel method of reducing the size of a dual-polarized LP antenna for high-power bidirectional operation by 2.3x while retaining its high-power capability and dual-circular polarization characteristics.

the presented antenna design and its fabrication is a step towards a more efficient, compact and high power capable dual-polarized bidirectional LP antenna for high power transmit and receive systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed antenna is the smallest dual-CP LP antenna for bidirectional operation.
we have developed a novel dual-CP LP antenna for high-power applications that is 2 times smaller and 4 times lighter than conventional 4-arm CP LPs.
a high-power capable bidirectional dual-CP antenna is presented that is 2/3 of the size of its predecessor.

the antenna is 2.5 times smaller than the state-of-the-art 4-arm LP antenna and has a much larger bandwidth.
a 4-arm LP can be made 2.3 smaller than the conventional one by using the proposed concept and thus can find use in many high-power applications where size is critical.
